title: kouno maka'n me ghul hai bapa wawaila
body:
kouno maka'n me ghul hai bapa wawaila, kargaye baqar aaj qaza wawaila
mit gaya haye haye aaj jaha'n se , naamo nishaane zainulleba wawaila
qabr me hai bechain hyder wawaila, roohe payambar hai muztar wawaila
pote ke gham me qaak basar hai, roohe janaabe qairunnisa wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
deen ke sulta'n ko maara wawaila, sarware zeeshaa'n ko maara wawaila
kehte hai sab ansaaro mawaali, peet ke sar ye aaho buka wawaila
haaye hue paida jab se , ranjo alam sehte hi rahe wawaila
karbobala me qatl hua sab , saamne aankho me kunba wawaila
